reviews.text: Been going here for decades. They have dedicated staff and a great caring veterinarian. Located just off the 118 freeway at sepulveda.
Moscotas olvidioguzman

This is a hidden gem for pet owners in the SFV. We have three dogs and have had numerous veterinary visits and procedures all over the valley over the last ten years. We just got two of our dogs teeth taken care of and the others ear medicated here. This place is not only more reasonably priced but clearly more empathetic and compassionate about taking care of our animals then any other place in the past. Thank you Granada Veterinary Clinic for taking such good care of our dogs and we look forward to you taking care of them moving forward as long as we have them!
I have never seen a group of more caring individuals! I get anxiety when I take my cats to the vet, it's so important to have a compassionate veterinarian to ease my mind.

Dr. Galdjian and her staff are amazing. We went through so many vets until we came across Granada Veterinary. We are so thankful for the years of caring, compassionate, and competent care they provided for our dog. They truly care, take time to understand your pet’s needs, and communicate very well. They are the best!!!!!
Been our vet for many years and many pets. They are lovely, caring and compassionate people. 5 stars! Big shout outs to Gabriel, Becky and Dr.G!!!
Professional, friendly and genuine. Great doctor and staff

I took my dog here because they were the closest vets who could do a BAER test on a 2 year old pup who we suspected was shard of hearing for a long time. The vet was honest and mentioned if we suspect something, he probably has it and let us decide if we wanted to spend money or not. For the longest time we didn't think we needed testing until our dog started becoming aggressive towards other dogs with no warning and behaviorists recommended that we get him checked to know for sure and understand what's scaring him, so we just did it. We had NO idea he was 100% deaf, and now everything makes sense! The staff were all very friendly and attentive, they treated my dog very well, and he didn't even need sedation. I also really appreciated the transparency of pricing and everything before we decided to go ahead with the test. This test has changed everything and we are so thankful we went to this clinic.
Good visit. Entire staff is very friendly and cordial.
Friendly, caring, knowledgeable staff. I'm very satisfied with how well my dog was treated.
Absolutely the best vet clinic I've ever been to. Dr G and her staff are exceptional. It's a long drive for me but well worth it. Highly recommended!!
Excellent service!
Friendly staff and knowledgeable vet.
Dr G is the best and the staff is amazing!
Seriously the service was excellent

Best vet dr ever. Dr G and her staff treat our babies family. She is very informative and caring. Her staff is vey professional and caring. The office is always very clean and always available for help.

My dog, Doozie, told me if I didn't write a review and it better be a good one or else no more tail wagging and he might not ask to go outside when nature calls.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The place and people are outstanding.
5 stars all around for the loving care they give my friend.
_________________________________________________

OK Doozie? Is that good enough?
Yes now you can take me out although I had my eye on the middle of that white runner for a deposit.

I’ve been going to the veterinary office for at least 10 years or more. There were things in the past that bothered me but I really wanted to support a woman owned business. Before I left, expect to wait, I had to even leave once because it was an hour wait and came back later and I had an appointment. It’s pricey, I paid 250.00 with no office visit for another urinalysis. The office visit is $92.50 and if your baby has surgery they charge on top a half day stay all while your baby is just waking up
from the anesthesia, that’s a bit steep and makes you feel like you’re being nickel-and-dimed but still I wanted to support her business. Also it’s highly inappropriate and unprofessional to talk politics, I’m there to take care of my babies not hear you feel both side are the same…
The straw that broke was the incident with the vet tech, when I asked about the bloodwork for my dog. She informed me that I received the bloodwork information already. I again said, I have not that I did received a call about the   results of the urinalysis. She then informed me again that Becky called me with that information. I did then inform her that I didn’t appreciate her telling me that I did and I’m sure my face reflected my own irritation. Bottom line let’s not go back and forth,  just give the client the info, even if I didn’t remember just go over it again… don’t keep repeated you received it, it doesn’t accomplish anything. Dr G is a really good vet and has a good bedside manner. Unfortunately the cons now outweigh the pros. Not sure if it’s her new crew but if this is how they’re going to roll, I’m sure I won’t be the last one leaving, they just lost 5 clients with my babies. Found another good vet closer to home. It’s more reasonable and it’s not reminiscent of VCA prices. You’re only as good as the staff that represent you.

Affordable. I didn't have pet insurance so I was a little nervous about how much I was gonna have to pay. Was not bad. I would definitely take my cat back for anything else. And the people that work there are very nice. Made me feel comfortable even with my worries.

Dr. G is a true gem when it comes to allergy testing for pets. My dog was suffering from persistent allergies, and Dr. G went above and beyond to identify the triggers and create a tailored treatment plan. The quality of care was impeccable. While the testing can be a bit pricey, the relief it brought to my furry friend was priceless. Dr. G's expertise is worth every dollar spent.

My friend/neighbor recommended Granada Veterinary Clinic for the care of our new Border Collie puppy. Our boy is 2 years old now and we have had nothing but wonderful experiences with staff and the level of care. Jamie and Becky at the front are amazing and always greet pet parents with a smile. The veterinary techs are also super nice and compassionate with the fur babies. Dr. G is also attentive to our concerns, helpful and extremely conscientious when it comes to cost while giving the utmost in veterinary care. Although, appointments are required, they made an exception and squeezed us in when our puppy hurt his paw. Their kindness is amazing.  I highly recommend this veterinary office to anyone who wants a veterinarian who IS about the animals, not just the money.
Courteus service and attentive

Excellent care. My puppy needed a PENHIP study and after calling 7 places I finally found GVC. They were able to get her in almost immediately and did a thorough exam before the x rays. The Dr was able to give me the answers I have been looking for for weeks.
Been a customer here for over 25 years. Staff are wonderful and very caring with animals. Becky is the best!

Granada Veterinary Clinic is an amazing place for pet care.

I love how much they love my pets.

Walked in with my pet because of something we are concerened about and did not want to wait. Instead of being greeted with helpful questions about our concerns, I was notified that it would be $150 just for walking in for an appointment. My wife and I are professionals, but like many places in our neighborhood we feel that we don't get the same courtesy we might get in more afluent places. This is not just front staff, but the Vet has also made comments that felt more like judgments rather than useful advice. If you must go there, then do so, but I am taking my business where I am not made to feel like I am inconveniencing the staff.
Amazing staff and Veterinarian. Extremely kind and attentive to my pets.  Veterinarian was caring and knowledgeable.   This is a great place to bring your pets.
The best vet in the valley. Always takes great care of my boxers. The young lady behind the desk is awesome. And the vet has these gorgeous green/hazel eyes 👀🤩 …
Excellent service, really felt like they cared for our pet.
Have been bringing my pets as a pet parent to this place for over a decade...! Great place to receive a veterinary care...Awesome staff...!!!

Well I never even made it in the door. I called about a rabies shot and was told a $100 exam was required to give a rabies shot. Just seems a little to pricey to give a $20 shot. I ended up going to pacoima pet clinic and was only charged $10 in total.
They do a great job and are very kind and knowledgeable and prices are fair
Great experience
